# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime efficiency and reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 improves rendering reliability across platforms while reducing managed allocation overhead. It strengthens Android and Linux native integration, packages WebGPU support more reliably, and raises the Apple native deployment baseline.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Texture rendering now synchronizes with the display refresh cycle for more dependable Android presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams retain their source** — Front-buffered managed streams now keep the wrapped stream alive for their full lifetime, preventing premature release during native reads. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed hot paths allocate less** — Image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 input, and feature-string decoding avoid unnecessary allocations without changing their results. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Apple native packages use current deployment baselines** — The iOS, macOS, and tvOS native builds now align their minimum deployment settings with supported Apple toolchains. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebGPU native support is packaged with static libraries** — WebAssembly consumers receive the emdawnwebgpu implementation inside libSkiaSharp.a, making the native WebGPU dependency available with the library. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Linux uses its bundled HarfBuzz symbols** — Linux native builds bind HarfBuzz functions from the bundled library, avoiding interference from separately installed system libraries. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
